name: Desmuma
text: Desmuma is the Old Irish form of the place-name Desmond. It records the southern Munster territory before the modern counties took shape. Modern readers meet Desmuma chiefly as a citation form in dictionaries. The headword itself is brief and points onward to the fuller Desmond entry. Scholars treat Desmuma and Deasmhumhain as two spellings of the same territory. Either form places the land in the south of Munster. The territory kept that older name in literary Irish long after English administration divided it. See the Desmond entry for the political and dynastic history.

okr.objective: Desmuma as the Old Irish literary form of the territory also called Desmond in South Munster.
